tokens.name: az-bg
tokens.usage: Page background: warm paper-white. Muggulu line patterns sit on it in az-gold.

tokens.name: az-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, nav bar, inputs. One soft shadow (az-shadow-card) lifts it off az-bg.

tokens.name: az-surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fills inside a card: DayRibbon track, segmented-control track, read-only fields. Addition to the brief.

tokens.name: az-ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on az-bg, az-surface, az-surface-sunk and every *-soft fill (≥12:1 both themes).

tokens.name: az-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, end times, captions, reasons. On az-bg, az-surface, az-surface-sunk and every *-soft fill (≥5.4:1 both themes).

tokens.name: az-line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control. Addition.

tokens.name: az-line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, unchecked boxes, switch tracks, secondary buttons (≥3.5:1 on az-surface, az-bg and az-surface-sunk). Addition.

tokens.name: az-kumkum
tokens.usage: Primary actions only: the one main button per screen, selected chip fill, active nav pill. Text on it is az-on-kumkum.

tokens.name: az-on-kumkum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an az-kumkum fill (5.9:1 light, 4.7:1 dark). Dark mode flips to dark ink because white on #e5484d is only 3.8:1.

tokens.name: az-kumkum-ink
tokens.usage: Kumkum as TEXT: links, the Why link, active nav label. On az-surface, az-bg and az-kumkum-soft (≥4.8:1 both themes). Addition: dark #e5484d is 4.3:1 on az-surface, too low for 14px text.

tokens.name: az-kumkum-soft
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected tint for chips, nav items and wish cards. Text on it: az-ink or az-kumkum-ink.

tokens.name: az-turmeric
tokens.usage: Highlight fills and the DayRibbon "now" marker. Never text, never on its own on az-surface (1.8:1 light): pair with an az-ink outline or label.

tokens.name: az-on-turmeric
tokens.usage: Text on an az-turmeric fill, both themes (9.0:1 / 10.0:1). Addition: light az-ink would fail on dark-mode turmeric.

tokens.name: az-turmeric-soft
tokens.usage: "Today" / "recommended" highlight band behind a row or card. Text on it: az-ink, az-ink-muted.

tokens.name: az-leaf
tokens.usage: Good (శుభం): status chip fill, good segments on DayRibbon, GunaDial arc ≥ 24/36. Always with the lotus icon.

tokens.name: az-on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an az-leaf fill (5.1:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: az-leaf-ink
tokens.usage: Good as TEXT or icon on az-surface and az-leaf-soft (≥5.6:1 both themes).

tokens.name: az-leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Good tint: KootaRow at full marks, Good chip (soft variant), Amrita kalam band.

tokens.name: az-caution
tokens.usage: Mixed (మిశ్రమం): fill and arc only; text on it is az-on-caution. Always with the half-diya icon.

tokens.name: az-on-caution
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an az-caution fill (5.4:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: az-caution-ink
tokens.usage: Mixed as TEXT or icon on az-surface and az-caution-soft (≥5.4:1 both themes). Addition: az-caution as text is 3.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: az-caution-soft
tokens.usage: Mixed tint: DoshaCallout background, partial-score KootaRow, Mixed chip (soft variant).

tokens.name: az-avoid
tokens.usage: Avoid (వర్జించండి): fill for avoid windows, always with diagonal stripes and the crossed-circle icon. Text on it: az-on-avoid.

tokens.name: az-on-avoid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an az-avoid fill (9.0:1 light, 4.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: az-avoid-ink
tokens.usage: Avoid as TEXT or icon on az-surface and az-avoid-soft (≥6.3:1 both themes).

tokens.name: az-avoid-soft
tokens.usage: Avoid tint: zero-score KootaRow, Avoid chip (soft variant), avoid rows in the DayRibbon list.

tokens.name: az-gold
tokens.usage: Temple gold: card borders on special cards (ShareCard, Reveal), muggulu lines, GunaDial dots. Decorative only (3.1:1 on az-bg light) — never body text.

tokens.name: az-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Faint muggulu background pattern and the unfilled GunaDial track. Decorative.

tokens.name: az-thoranam
tokens.usage: Thoranam green for the mango-leaf festoon ornament only (same value as az-leaf, separate name so decoration never reads as status).

tokens.name: az-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (≥4.8:1 on az-surface and az-bg).

tokens.name: az-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind WhySheet and other bottom sheets.

styles.name: te-display-lg
styles.usage: Reveal headline, GunaDial score label, onboarding slides. Ramabhadra has one weight; never fake bold.

styles.name: te-title
styles.usage: Card titles, WishCard title, sheet titles. Addition between display and body.

styles.name: te-body
styles.usage: Body copy in Telugu: 17px (1px above English) so vowel signs and ottulu read clearly.

styles.name: te-label
styles.usage: Chips, buttons, nav labels, form labels.

styles.name: te-caption
styles.usage: Reasons, helper text, approximate labels. Smallest Telugu size: never below 14px.

styles.name: en-display-lg
styles.sample: Your wishes, read by the panchangam

styles.name: en-title
styles.usage: Card titles, WishCard title, sheet titles.

styles.name: en-body
styles.sample: Avoid starting new work during Rahu kalam.

styles.name: en-label
styles.usage: Chips, buttons, nav labels, form labels.

styles.name: times
styles.usage: Every clock time and score. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (class az-times) so columns align.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: GunaDial and DateResultCard score numerals. Addition.

tokens.name: az-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: az-space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; label-to-field.

tokens.name: az-space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding inside lists; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: az-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen side margin at 360–390px.

tokens.name: az-space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on hero cards (Reveal, GunaDial).

tokens.name: az-space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap on a screen.

tokens.name: az-space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a screen title; sheet top padding.

tokens.name: az-space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (az-touch) and bottom-nav height above the safe area.

tokens.name: az-radius-sm
tokens.usage: DayRibbon segments, checkboxes, small tags. Addition.

tokens.name: az-radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons. Addition.

tokens.name: az-radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card and the top corners of sheets.

tokens.name: az-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, LangToggle, nav active pill: fully rounded.

tokens.name: az-shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on az-bg, BottomNav, sheets. Cards lift 2px on press with this same shadow — no second level.

tokens.name: az-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every tappable element.

tokens.name: az-icon
tokens.usage: Default line-icon box; 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: az-screen
tokens.usage: Design frame width; also check every screen at 360px.

tokens.name: az-elder-scale
tokens.usage: Elder mode multiplies every text size by this (+20%). Components read --az-scale; set it from this token on .az-elder.
